question: According to Census of India 2011, identify the third largest spoken language in India.
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Marathi__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **2011 Census of India**, **Marathi **ranks as the** third most spoken** language in the country.
 
• It is spoken by approximately** 8.3 crore people**, constituting around** 6.86%** of the nation's population.
 
• Marathi is an **Indo-Aryan language** primarily spoken by the Marathi people of Maharashtra.
 
• It holds the status of being the official language of Maharashtra and serves as a co-official language in Goa.
 
• Marathi exhibits a rich linguistic diversity, with nearly 42 different dialects being identified within its realm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamil, **a Dravidian language, is spoken by approximately 6.90 crore individuals, accounting for 5.70% of the total population. It is predominantly spoken in regions such as Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and the Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
 
• **Bengali**, the second most spoken language in India, boasts 9.72 crore speakers, constituting 8.03% of the population.
 
• **Hindi **holds the title of the most spoken language in India, with 52.83 crore speakers making up 43.63% of the population, as per the 2011 Indian Census.
